findings.name: PDF Syntax (ISO 32000-1) Core
findings.message: PDF version 1.4 supports standard accessibility features.
findings.description: The PDF file must conform to ISO 32000-1 syntax rules and allow accessibility content extraction.
findings.remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

findings.name: PDF Syntax (ISO 32000-1) Core
findings.message: Document is not encrypted; accessibility content extraction is unrestricted.
findings.description: The PDF file must conform to ISO 32000-1 syntax rules and allow accessibility content extraction.
findings.remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

findings.name: Fonts Embedded
findings.message: All 3 font(s) in the document are embedded.
findings.description: All fonts used in the document must be embedded or embedded as subsets (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.2).
findings.remediation: Embed all fonts when exporting the PDF from your authoring tool (e.g. Word, InDesign) or in Adobe Acrobat Preflight.

findings.name: ToUnicode CMaps
findings.message: Font 'AAAAAA+Arial-BoldMT' lacks an explicit /ToUnicode mapping stream.
findings.description: Fonts must provide Unicode mapping (ToUnicode CMap) so assistive technology can reliably voice the text.
findings.remediation: Convert font to OpenType/TrueType with explicit Unicode mappings before exporting to PDF.

findings.name: ToUnicode CMaps
findings.message: Font 'AAAAAA+ArialMT' lacks an explicit /ToUnicode mapping stream.
findings.description: Fonts must provide Unicode mapping (ToUnicode CMap) so assistive technology can reliably voice the text.
findings.remediation: Convert font to OpenType/TrueType with explicit Unicode mappings before exporting to PDF.

findings.name: Tagged PDF
findings.message: Document is explicitly marked as a Tagged PDF with a structure tree.
findings.description: The document must be marked as a Tagged PDF in the document Catalog dictionary (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.1).
findings.evidence: Catalog/MarkInfo/Marked is true and StructTreeRoot exists.
findings.remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open Accessibility tool and select 'Add Tags to Document', or check 'Document is tagged PDF' in Word/InDesign export settings.

findings.name: Real Content Tagged
findings.message: All pages with text content are associated with the structure tree.
findings.description: All real content on each page must be tagged or marked as an Artifact.
findings.remediation: Inspect untagged elements in the PDF structure pane and tag them or mark them as background artifacts.

findings.name: Embedded Files
findings.message: No non-conforming embedded files detected in the document.
findings.description: Embedded files must conform to PDF/UA or have descriptions explaining their format and accessibility status.
findings.remediation: Ensure attached files are in accessible formats or provide an accessible alternative description.

findings.name: Document Language
findings.message: Document primary natural language is specified as 'en-US'.
findings.description: The natural language of the document must be specified in the document Catalog (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.3).
findings.remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Advanced > Reading Options, and select the correct Language (e.g. English US).

findings.name: Language Shifts
findings.message: All 0 element-level language override(s) have valid BCP 47 codes.
findings.description: Content in a language different from the document's primary language must be tagged with a /Lang attribute.
findings.remediation: Select the foreign-language text span in Acrobat Pro's Tag Tree, open Properties, and set the Language attribute.

findings.name: Structure Tree Root
findings.message: Structure tree has a compliant top-level structural container.
findings.description: The structure tree must have a valid StructTreeRoot with a top-level Document or Part container.
findings.remediation: Ensure the root of the structure tree is tagged as Document or Part in Acrobat Pro Tag Tree.

findings.name: Structure Elements Nesting
findings.message: All structural lists, tables, and container elements conform to standard nesting rules.
findings.description: Structural elements must be nested logically according to ISO 32000-1 (e.g. TR inside Table, LI inside L).
findings.remediation: Fix nesting in the Tag Tree so lists contain LI, tables contain TR, and TR contains TH/TD.

findings.name: Empty Structure Elements
findings.message: Empty structure element <H1> has no child tags or marked content.
findings.description: Structure elements should not be empty unless they serve as structural grouping containers.
findings.remediation: Remove empty tags in the tag tree.

findings.name: Role Mapping
findings.message: All custom structure types are properly mapped to standard structure types.
findings.description: Non-standard structure types must be mapped in the /RoleMap dictionary directly or indirectly to standard structure types.
findings.remediation: Open the Role Map in Acrobat Pro (Tags Panel > Options > Edit Role Map) and map custom tags to standard PDF tags.

findings.name: Alternative Descriptions
findings.message: No graphical figures or formulas found in the document.
findings.description: Every Figure and Formula element must possess an alternative description (/Alt) or /ActualText (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.18).
findings.remediation: In Acrobat Pro, right-click Figure tag > Properties > Tag tab > Alternative Text, and enter a descriptive alternative.

findings.name: Metadata
findings.message: XMP metadata stream is present.
findings.description: The PDF must contain an XMP metadata stream containing a document title (dc:title) and a PDF/UA identifier.
findings.remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

findings.name: Metadata
findings.message: Document Title is defined: 'Annual Accessibility and Technology Report 2026'.
findings.description: The PDF must contain an XMP metadata stream containing a document title (dc:title) and a PDF/UA identifier.
findings.remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

findings.name: Metadata
findings.message: Document declares PDF/UA compliance (Part 1).
findings.description: The PDF must contain an XMP metadata stream containing a document title (dc:title) and a PDF/UA identifier.
findings.remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

findings.name: Document settings
findings.message: DisplayDocTitle is set to true in ViewerPreferences.
findings.description: ViewerPreferences must have DisplayDocTitle set to true so user agents display the document title in the title bar (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.10).
findings.remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Initial View, and under 'Window Options' set 'Show' to 'Document Title' instead of 'File Name'.

findings.name: Document settings
findings.message: Page tab navigation conforms to document structure order.
findings.description: ViewerPreferences must have DisplayDocTitle set to true so user agents display the document title in the title bar (ISO 14289-1, Clause 7.10).
findings.evidence: Tab order is set to Structure (/Tabs /S) across pages.
findings.remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Initial View, and under 'Window Options' set 'Show' to 'Document Title' instead of 'File Name'.

findings.name: 1.1 Text Alternatives
findings.message: No non-text content (images, figures) found in the document.
findings.description: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose (WCAG SC 1.1.1).
findings.remediation: Add descriptive alternative text to all non-decorative images and figures.

findings.name: 1.2 Time-based Media
findings.message: No time-based multimedia or audio/video streams detected.
findings.description: Provide alternatives for time-based media such as video or audio embedded in the PDF.
findings.remediation: Provide synchronized captions or text transcripts for embedded media.

findings.name: 1.3 Adaptable
findings.message: Document contains 1 structured heading element(s).
findings.description: Create content that can be presented in different ways without losing information or structure (WCAG SC 1.3.1, 1.3.2).
findings.remediation: Ensure headings, tables, and lists use appropriate structural tags.

findings.name: 1.4 Distinguishable
findings.message: Verify color contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) and ensure color is not the only means of conveying information.
findings.description: Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background (Contrast SC 1.4.3).
findings.evidence: Color contrast requires visual sampling or human verification.
findings.remediation: Verify visual contrast of text against background meets 4.5:1 for regular text and 3:1 for large text.

findings.name: 2.1 Keyboard Accessible
findings.message: Document has no interactive controls or links requiring tab navigation.
findings.description: Make all functionality available from a keyboard without keyboard traps (WCAG SC 2.1.1, 2.1.2).
findings.evidence: No links or form widgets detected.
findings.remediation: Ensure page tab navigation follows document structure order.

findings.name: 2.2 Enough Time
findings.message: No timed transitions, automated page flips, or timeouts detected.
findings.description: Provide users enough time to read and use content (WCAG SC 2.2.1).
findings.remediation: Do not set automated timeouts or slide transitions without user pause controls.

findings.name: 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions
findings.message: No flashing or rapid animated content detected in the document.
findings.description: Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions (WCAG SC 2.3.1).
findings.remediation: Avoid animations or blinking content that flashes more than three times in any one-second period.

findings.name: 2.4 Navigable
findings.message: Document has a descriptive title: 'Annual Accessibility and Technology Report 2026'.
findings.description: Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are (Title SC 2.4.2, Link Purpose SC 2.4.4, Bookmarks SC 2.4.5).
findings.remediation: Set document title, provide bookmarks for long documents, and write descriptive link text.

findings.name: 2.5 Input Modalities
findings.message: No input modality conflicts detected with touch or pointer gestures.
findings.description: Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard (WCAG SC 2.5.3).
findings.remediation: Ensure visible text labels match accessible names.

findings.name: 3.1 Readable
findings.message: Language of document is specified as 'en-US'.
findings.description: Make text content readable and understandable (Language of Page SC 3.1.1, Language of Parts SC 3.1.2).
findings.remediation: Set default document language and mark language switches.

findings.name: 3.2 Predictable
findings.message: Interactive fields and links operate predictably without unexpected context changes.
findings.description: Make Web/PDF pages appear and operate in predictable ways (On Focus SC 3.2.1, On Input SC 3.2.2).
findings.evidence: Action triggers conform to standard behavior.
findings.remediation: Avoid automated submit actions or context jumps when form fields receive focus.

findings.name: 3.3 Input Assistance
findings.message: No interactive form fields found in document.
findings.description: Help users avoid and correct mistakes (Labels or Instructions SC 3.3.2).
findings.remediation: Provide clear tooltips (/TU) or accessible labels for all interactive form fields.

findings.name: 4.1 Compatible
findings.message: Document semantic tagging and extraction permissions are compatible with assistive technology.
findings.description: Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies (Name, Role, Value SC 4.1.2).
findings.evidence: Tagged PDF with accessibility permissions enabled.
findings.remediation: Ensure all interactive elements have accessible names and standard structural roles.

findings.name: Heading Hierarchy Integrity
findings.message: Heading hierarchy is logically consistent across all 1 heading(s).
findings.description: Headings must not skip levels (e.g. H1 followed immediately by H3 without an intervening H2).
findings.remediation: Adjust heading levels in your authoring tool so they increment smoothly without skipping levels.

findings.name: Table Regularity & Symmetry
findings.message: No data tables found in document.
findings.description: Data tables should maintain consistent column/row dimensions and avoid empty header cells.
findings.remediation: Ensure table cells align evenly and provide descriptive column and row headers.

findings.name: Meaningful Link Labels
findings.message: No hyperlinks found in document.
findings.description: Hyperlink labels should be meaningful out of context to assist screen reader users.
findings.remediation: Replace vague labels like 'click here' or bare URLs with clear descriptions of the destination.

findings.name: Alt-Text Semantic Quality
findings.message: No figures present requiring AI semantic evaluation.
findings.description: Evaluates whether image alternative text conveys actual information rather than trivial labels or redundant prefixes like 'image of...'.
findings.remediation: Write concise, descriptive alt text that explains what the image illustrates without saying 'image of' or 'graphic of'.

findings.name: Cognitive Readability Score
findings.message: Flesch Reading Ease score: 0.0/100 (Very Complex / Specialized). Avg sentence length: 19.5 words.
findings.description: Calculates Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease and average sentence complexity to support cognitive accessibility.
findings.remediation: Simplify sentence structures and reduce jargon where possible for broad audience comprehension.

findings.name: Structural Outline Consistency
findings.message: Document structural outline and navigation elements are well-proportioned.
findings.description: Analyzes bookmarks against tagged heading structure to ensure cohesive navigation.
findings.remediation: Synchronize document bookmarks with the heading hierarchy.
